examples.description: Remove a line only if nobody changed it since your read

failure_modes.recovery: For a paid invoice, retire the payment first (invoice_payment_delete, approval required). A cancelled invoice keeps its lines as issued.
failure_modes.when: the parent invoice is paid (its total is ledger-locked) or cancelled (terminal)

failure_modes.recovery: Resend with expected_updated_at set to the line's updated_at from your read (the refusal names the current value; invoice_item_read or quote_item_read shows the line).
failure_modes.when: expected_updated_at is missing: every line edit or removal carries the updated_at of the line it was made against

failure_modes.recovery: Call invoice_read to see the invoice's current status and lines; nothing was written.
failure_modes.when: the invoice became paid or cancelled, or the line was removed or changed, while this delete ran, or expected_updated_at no longer matches the line

preconditions: Soft delete: the line leaves the invoice and its totals immediately; the row is retired for audit history, never removed.
If retiring the line settles the arithmetic (payments plus credits ≥ the new total on a partially-paid invoice), the parent re-derives to 'paid' — status always agrees with its ledger.
Lines of a PAID or CANCELLED invoice are locked.

description: Soft-deletes a line item — it leaves the invoice and its derived total immediately, but the row is retired for audit history, never removed. expected_updated_at is required: the line's updated_at from your read (invoice_item_read); without it the removal is refused and the refusal names the current value. Refuses when the parent invoice is 'paid' (ledger-locked: retire the payment first) or 'cancelled' (terminal: its lines stay as issued), and with CONFLICT when the line changed since that read (read it again). If retiring the line settles the remaining balance on a partially-paid invoice, the parent re-derives to 'paid' by itself. NEXT: invoice_read to see the updated total.

expected_updated_at.description: Required: the line's updated_at from your last read (invoice_item_read, invoice_item_list or the create answer). Left out, the call is refused and names the current value; a line changed since then returns CONFLICT with the current value and stays as it is.

name: invoice_item_delete
